acceptance_rule: CSV files parse with DictReader and contain required Phase 5 contract columns
notes: Required before a sampled derivative fixture can feed the diagnostic lane.

acceptance_rule: All fixture and sampled cell identifiers are nonempty and unique
notes: Protects joins between fixture cells manifests and derived inventory rows.

acceptance_rule: Derived inventory includes all six planned fixture cells and covers all active BC mini SCANFI+Gauthier supply nodes
notes: Ensures Phase 6 does not drop a diagnostic supply path.

acceptance_rule: Every P5.2 required SCANFI layer has a manifest row for every P5.1 fixture cell
notes: Confirms the five selected SCANFI layers are represented before derived values are accepted.

acceptance_rule: Representative and sampled areas are nonnegative and sampled area does not exceed representative area
notes: Area accounting is diagnostic QA only until production sampling design is accepted.

acceptance_rule: Sampled numeric values and valid pixel counts are nonnegative
notes: Prevents impossible negative sampled summaries from entering the diagnostic lane.

acceptance_rule: Valid plus nodata pixel counts equal total pixel count and valid pixel count is greater than zero
notes: Uses the P5.2 nodata policy without claiming production sampling adequacy.

acceptance_rule: Mean biomass proxy is between 0 and 1000 tonnes per ha
notes: Broad sanity range only and not a calibrated biomass acceptance threshold.

acceptance_rule: Mean height is between 0 and 80 metres
notes: Broad sanity range only.

acceptance_rule: Mean canopy closure is between 0 and 100 percent
notes: Closure outside percent bounds is invalid for diagnostic use.

acceptance_rule: Median age is between 0 and 400 years
notes: Broad sanity range for the diagnostic Gauthier age predictor.

acceptance_rule: Landcover summary is present and forest_candidate logic is explicit for each sampled cell
notes: Accepts diagnostic forest mask logic without final production species composition policy.

acceptance_rule: Observed CRS and resolution match the extraction contract
notes: Prevents mixing incompatible raster summaries in the tiny fixture.

acceptance_rule: Each window and manifest row has nonempty SHA-256 checksum fields
notes: Confirms auditability of tiny DataLad outputs.

acceptance_rule: Each derived row can be traced to fixture cell source layer source manifest and license position
notes: Supports public-safe diagnostic provenance.

acceptance_rule: Value policy and materialization labels are explicit and do not claim production readiness
notes: Labels must distinguish planned design sampled diagnostic and production states.

acceptance_rule: Accepted residue generation or recovery factor remains unresolved for production
notes: Diagnostic lane may keep residue visible but production residue yield is not accepted.

acceptance_rule: Cost and price assumptions require sourced year currency region and unit basis before production use
notes: Synthetic diagnostic costs must not be treated as calibrated economics.

acceptance_rule: Climate predictor source and normal period remain unresolved for production
notes: Gauthier diagnostic method reproduction can proceed separately from production climate selection.

acceptance_rule: NFI access reuse and report archiving status must be resolved before production validation
notes: NFI material remains outside parent repo unless access and license review permit use.

acceptance_rule: Production benchmark validation requires accepted benchmark sources and calibrated policy inputs
notes: Conceptual alpha can report diagnostic QA while production benchmarks remain open.
